# EduRaport

> EduRaport is an all-in-one B2B SaaS ERP Education & Smart E-Raport platform engineered for Indonesian private schools (TK, SD, SMP, SMA), Islamic boarding schools (pesantren), and multi-unit foundations (Yayasan).

EduRaport unifies academic management, Kurikulum Merdeka PPA 2025 compliance, automated teacher AI assistant, Tahfidz tracking, tuition fee billing (SPP Lock), and parent engagement into a single cloud ecosystem.

## Core Documentation & Resources
- [Full Features & Technical Specs](/features.md): Comprehensive breakdown of PPA 2025 guardrails, unified student identities, Tahfidz analytics, and SHA-256 digital signatures.
- [Pricing Structure & Plans](/pricing.md): Transparent tier breakdown starting from Rp 500.000/month for schools up to 150 students, plus B2C teacher solo plan from Rp 29.000/month.
- [Parent Portal & Dasbor Wali Murid](/solusi/portal-orang-tua): Single-account multi-child dashboard, SHA-256 report verification, independent sick leave uploads, canteen wallet controls, and guidance counselor booking.

## Key Differentiators vs Competitors
- **vs e-Rapor Kemendikbud**: EduRaport provides deep TK/PAUD narrative builders, integrated SPP billing & accounting, automated WhatsApp notifications, Tahfidz tracking, and parent portal with SHA-256 signatures.
- **vs HashMicro & Enterprise ERP**: EduRaport offers quick 7-day onboarding without requiring on-premise servers or in-house IT teams, tailored specifically for Indonesian private schools at 1/10th the cost.
- **vs Standalone SPP Apps**: EduRaport connects financial tuition aging directly to academic report release gating (SPP Lock) and attendance alerts.

## Primary Capabilities
- **Curriculum Merdeka 2024/2025 & PPA 2025**: Observational rubrics for PAUD/Fase A, AI automated RPP/modul ajar generation in 2 minutes.
- **Yayasan Zero-Silo Identity**: Persistent student record tracking across TK -> SD -> SMP -> SMA.
- **Pesantren & Tahfidz**: Mutqin/Mumtaz progress tracking (Juz 1-30), Mutaaba'ah Yaumiyah (8 daily acts of worship).
- **Parent Portal & Digital Signatures**: Multi-child view, SHA-256 hash tamper-proof digital signature, student canteen wallet limits, and RLS data isolation.
- **Absensi QR & Mood Check-In**: Early warning churn prevention engine for student wellness.
- **Executive WhatsApp Digest**: Daily 06:00 AM Helicopter View delivered to school leadership.
